label: Brisnik: INSO3
title: Mirtazapine at 30 mg a day or more for sleep
statement: Prescribed mirtazapine ≥ 30 mg/day for insomnia - and the patient has no other indications for an antidepressant

plain_summary: Review mirtazapine prescribed at 30 mg a day or more for insomnia when the person has no other indication for an antidepressant.

needs_facts.what: Reason for mirtazapine on the course being reviewed for insomnia
needs_facts.meets: The record establishes treatment for insomnia and no other current indication for an antidepressant. A contemporaneous note or prescription direction can document purpose. A remote or unrelated diagnosis alone does not establish a current indication.

options.words: This medicine treated insomnia and there was no other current reason for an antidepressant
This medicine was prescribed for a reason other than insomnia
There was another current reason for an antidepressant

rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when mirtazapine (Group A) is supplied at a daily dose of 30 mg or more, worked out as mg per tablet times tablets per day, or mg per mL times mL per day for a liquid, using the prescribed directions (for example 30 mg, ONE at night is 30 mg). Confirm when the record establishes that the medicine was prescribed for insomnia and the person had no other current antidepressant indication. Cite the supply and indication evidence. Add strengths of the same medicine only when the directions explicitly prescribe them together. If the directions leave it unclear whether the prescribed dose reaches 30 mg a day, report only a possible finding unless another detail rules it out. Cite the unclear directions and ask what daily dose was prescribed. If the medicine meets the dose threshold but either indication detail is unknown, report a possible finding and name each missing detail. A bedtime direction alone leaves the purpose unknown. A documented purpose other than insomnia, or another current antidepressant indication, gives no finding.
cannot_be_seen: Why the medicine was started, whether it is really taken for sleep or pain, and any reason for an antidepressant that is not in the record. Doses taken in practice, tablets cut in half, and supplies from a hospital or another pharmacy.
ask_the_gp: Whether mirtazapine is still needed at this dose, whether it is being used for sleep, and whether a review or a lower dose is suitable.
